description: A sprite sheet of SIX separate props arranged in a grid of 2 columns and 3 rows (two props side by side in each row), each centered in its own wide cell, in this exact order: top row left: an elegant park bench with dark green painted wooden slats, curved black wrought iron armrests and legs with scroll ornaments, front view, wide and low, filling most of its cell; top row right: a rustic bench made of a split log on two short stumps; middle row left: a carved grey stone garden bench with lion paw legs; middle row right: a long wooden flower planter box full of red and yellow flowers; bottom row left: a small round wooden garden table with two little stools; bottom row right: a wooden garden swing seat hanging from a small A-frame with ropes, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, muted natural colors, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no water, no shadow puddles, no text, no numbers, no characters
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their 3 by 3 layout.
